children: Axis Bank Limited Sponsored GDR RegS (NSE:AXISBANK) reported strong Q2 FY27 growth in advances and deposits while analysts expect roughly 20% YoY private bank PAT lift; margin pressure from FCNR(B) mix, management exits and high futures rollover add near-term risk amid upbeat broker calls.
Previous Week Recap
Axis Bank Provisional Q2 FY27: Advances, Deposits Rise
: AXISBANK provisional Q2 FY27: gross advances Rs13.84–13.85Lcr (+22.7% YoY, +8.8% QoQ); deposits Rs14.52Lcr (+20.7% YoY, +5.8% QoQ); term deposits up 27.3% YoY; FCNR(B) $10.62B.
Motilal Oswal: Axisbank NII Growth Outlook
: Motilal Oswal forecasts AXISBANK Q2FY27: ~8.5% YoY NII growth, ~1.9% QoQ NII rise, and slightly lower credit costs due to reduced technical slippage.
GDR Helps Private Bank PAT Growth
: Analysts expect Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK) to help drive about 20% YoY private bank PAT growth for Q3 FY2027, citing a lower base at some banks, including Axis Bank.
GDR NIM Pressure From FCNR(B) Deposits
: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK) faces a quarterly net interest margin drop of about 5–10 bps due to FCNR(B) deposit pressure; year-on-year margins stay pressured versus a strong prior-year base.
GDR Rollover Dependence Concentrated
: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK) shows high futures rollover dependence, with rollover multiples between 8.5x and 10.4x across expiries, indicating concentrated rollover activity around expiry periods.
Axis Bank GDR Upside Potential
: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK): 49 buy, 3 hold; implied ~27.5% upside from current levels. Shares traded near ₹1,239 on Oct 6.
Senior Manager Sanjeev Moghe Resigns

: Axis Bank GDR (AXISBANK): Senior manager Sanjeev Moghe resigned Oct 4, 2026, effective Oct 30, 2026. He joined in Mar 2018, led Cards & Payments and branch controls. Resignation filed under SEBI 30.
Jefferies: Axis Bank Top Large-Cap Pick
: Jefferies India listed Axis Bank Sponsored GDR RegS (AXISBANK) as a top large-cap bank pick after RBI's 25 bp rate hike, noting potential earnings upside from tighter liquidity and rate shifts.
CFO Puneet Sharma Resigns
: AXISBANK: CFO Puneet Sharma resigned effective Aug 31 after six+ years; said his mandate to build a team, tighten controls and restore shareholder trust was largely complete.
Axis Capital Advises Jio Platforms IPO
: AXISBANK: Axis Capital, Axis Bank’s investment-banking unit, was named among 19 banks advising and underwriting Jio Platforms’ planned IPO; traders may note Axis Bank’s IPO-related advisory role.
